title: Umbrella with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- umbrella canopy -->
  <path d='M50,15 C25,15 10,35 8,50 L92,50 C90,35 75,15 50,15 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- canopy panels -->
  <path d='M50,15 C40,15 25,25 20,50 L35,50 C38,32 45,20 50,15 Z' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <path d='M50,15 C60,15 75,25 80,50 L65,50 C62,32 55,20 50,15 Z' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- canopy scallops -->
  <path d='M8,50 Q16,58 24,50 Q32,58 40,50 Q48,58 56,50 Q64,58 72,50 Q80,58 92,50' fill='none' stroke='#ffb703' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle stick -->
  <rect x='47' y='50' width='6' height='28' rx='3' fill='#a8dadc'/>
  <!-- curved handle -->
  <path d='M50,78 Q50,90 62,90 Q74,90 74,80' fill='none' stroke='#a8dadc' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top finial -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='4' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <!-- smiling face on canopy -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#1d3557'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#1d3557'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40,42 Q50,52 60,42' fill='none' stroke='#1d3557' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ff7b8a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ff7b8a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
